title: Some is not the same as all
sources: UPSC CSE notice: Prelims Paper II syllabus
Standard logic texts on categorical syllogisms

quiz.q: All pens are blue. Some blue things are cheap. Which follows?
quiz.why: Right. The cheap blue things may not be pens, and nothing rules out a cheap pen either.

lines.say: All doctors are graduates. Some graduates are singers.
So, are some doctors singers? Not necessarily.

beats.say: All doctors are graduates. Some graduates are singers. So, are some doctors singers? Not necessarily.

lines.say: Draw a circle for graduates, with doctors inside it.
The singers can sit in the part of the graduate circle that has no doctors.

data.text: The singers may be graduates who are not doctors.

beats.say: Draw a circle for graduates, with doctors inside it. The singers can sit in the part of the graduate circle that has no doctors.

lines.say: If all A are B, and all B are C, then all A are C.
And if some A are B, then some B are A. That one always reverses.
